objections.claim: The 'complete set the preflight needs' claim is false for the in-process path: cmdLightsOut(args, commands) builds knownCommands from its second parameter; a caller that does not thread faff's COMMANDS registry makes all seven CLI-backed guardrails read absent (FAFF-899 floor), so the preflight refuses before mintLightsOut is called.
objections.disposition_rationale: Spec-review judge p-01 UPHOLD_REVIEW: correction applied in place — the harness must thread the full COMMANDS registry into cmdLightsOut's second parameter (FAFF-899 floor) so the preflight is admitted to the mint.
